# Ahmad Arif

> Technical Project Manager from Karawang, Indonesia, with a software engineering background spanning backend systems, game development, and DevOps. Currently at PT. People Intelligence Indonesia (GreatDay HR).

## About

Ahmad Arif's interest in machine learning stems from graduate research in biomedical signal processing — EEG-based alertness and fatigue classification using wavelet transforms and neural networks.

## Tech stack

Node.js, Java, Python, Docker, Kubernetes

## Experience

- Jan 2019 - Present: Technical Project Manager at PT. People Intelligence Indonesia (GreatDay HR) — owns GreatDay's backend architecture and framework design across Employee, Career, Recruitment, and Workflow Approval modules.
- Mar 2018 - Oct 2018: Chief Technology Officer at PT. Digital Amanah Insani — led technology strategy for an Islamic-education LMS platform.
- 2017: Led development of a fuel-ordering app for SPBU owners in Karawang-Cikampek, connected to Pertamina's fuel terminal.
- Aug 2016 - Mar 2017: Software Developer at PT. Sarana Primadata, Jakarta — RESTful backend for the Directorate General of Taxes (KPDJP).
- Feb 2016 - Jan 2017: Java Web Developer at FTTM ITB — nationwide reporting system for SKK Migas drilling and reservoir data.
- 2016: Nationwide reporting platform for BPOM's safe-market field officers.
- Aug 2014 - Aug 2017: Founder, Game Developer at Gambite Studio.

## Education

- 2015 - 2018: Master of Engineering (M.T.) in Informatics, Institut Teknologi Bandung (ITB)
- 2010 - 2014: Bachelor of Computer Science (S.Kom.) in Informatics, Universitas Jenderal Achmad Yani (Unjani)
